summary: Circumstantial evidence sufficiency in murder case; bride burning (302 IPC); no eyewitness; standard: Panchsheel principles must point unequivocally to guilt; inconsistent witness testimony; FIR delay challenged; medical evidence on burn pattern disputed; alibi defence scrutinized; prosecution chain examined against innocence hypothesis; burden of proof beyond reasonable doubt.
legal_provisions_cited: Prabhudayal and Ors. v. State of Maharashtra
Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and life sentence for murder and destruction of evidence upheld
